title: Error
description: What a machine adapter writes on standard output before it exits with status 1: when check, make, list, log or delete fails, and on a usage error. A usage error, such as an unknown command or no --settings, is a failure of kind defect. The adapter exits with status 0 on success and 1 on failure, and with no other status. The answer is at most 1 MiB. It has no version. A member this schema does not define is refused.

kind.description: The kind of failure. limit: the request exceeded a limit at the vendor, such as a quota of machines. retry: a failure that a retry may clear, such as a timeout. defect: the request, the settings or the command line is wrong, and a retry fails the same way. other: any other failure.

message.description: What failed, display text, 1 to 200 characters.
